  • Ask

    What needs my attention?
  • How many guests have replied?
  • Who visited this week?
  • What errors did guests hit?

  • Console

    OverviewWhat needs you today, and how the site is doing.
  • AssistantAsk about guests, replies, visits and errors; plan and make changes.

  • Guests

    GuestsPeople, their households, sign-in resets.
  • Guest sheetSync the planning spreadsheet and see what differs from the site.
  • HouseholdsWho is invited together, and mailing addresses.
  • InvitationsIssue, rotate and revoke invitation links.
  • RSVPsWho has replied, meals, overrides, exports.
  • SeatingTables, assignments, publishing the chart.

  • Weekend

    ScheduleThe weekend day by day: events, times, rooms, menus, notices, the RSVP window.
  • Travel & stayHotels, links, the room block.
  • TransportRide benefits and voucher codes.
  • GiftsRegistry and gift links.
  • ReservationsVenues guests can book through.

  • Site

    DetailsDates and facts that show on several pages, changed once.
  • LifecycleThe state guests see, the calendar, previews.
  • ContentRecords with provenance and freshness.
  • FlagsFeature gates, and the legal switches that stay shut.
  • SitemapEvery endpoint the app serves.

  • Media

    MediaModeration queue, imports, duplicates.
  • Search indexCaptions, indexing, what the model may touch.
  • ConciergeAnswer traces, grounding failures, alerts.

  • Insight

    SessionsWho visited, the pages they opened, where they left.
  • ErrorsWhat broke for visitors, grouped, with the page it broke on.
  • MetricsCounters and timings this deployment recorded.
  • Audit trailEvery action anyone took, searchable, redacted.
  • JobsQueue depth, failures, retries.
  • ProvidersWhich adapter backs each integration.
